limitations: This is a compact research fixture, not a comprehensive historical-news archive.
Passages are concise paraphrases retained for offline replay; reviewers should use the source URLs for full context.
Corpus collection occurred after both assessment dates, so publication timing is supported by source-page metadata rather than a contemporaneous archive.
Date-only sources are assigned to midnight on the next calendar day in New York to prevent same-day look-ahead.
A source with an uncertain historical content version is retained only as an exclusion-control fixture.
market_close_convention: Assessment cutoff is 4:00 p.m. America/New_York on the as-of date. Only publication timestamps at or before that instant are eligible.
